pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal and stellate dark regions with highly serrated, jagged edge gradients. Patch spatial area is larger on the mid-dorsal region compared to the smaller, more compressed patches near the neck transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thin, cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Continuity is visually persistent but significantly attenuated in the lower-right quadrant due to foreground bokeh.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense mane is visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant foreground occlusion by out-of-focus yellow-green vegetation masking the textural detail of the lower-right flank.
